import polars as pl

# Create a sample DataFrame with duplicate rows

    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Alice", "Charlie", "Bob"],
    "age": [25, 30, 25, 35, 30],
    "city": ["New York", "London", "New York", "Paris", "London"]
})

# Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence
df_unique = df.unique()
